root_cause.text: A premature release of the network device reference count in the XFRM input path during asynchronous crypto resumption allows the device to be torn down while `skb->dev` is still referenced by subsequent Netfilter hooks.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes `dev_put(skb->dev)` from the async resumption logic in `net/xfrm/xfrm_input.c` and defers the reference drop until after `NF_HOOK` in `net/ipv4/xfrm4_input.c` and `net/ipv6/xfrm6_input.c`, directly addressing the race condition described where `skb->dev` is accessed after the device reference was incorrectly dropped.
